Page 250 Dec. 10 Patrick Coughtn - 13 - To-day serious - operation to-morrow
11 Mrs. Henretta Berry - 52 - two days to live, husband not Catholic promised rosary-a-day. Six weeks later no better, promised three rosaries a day and an hour later was on her feet ready for home.
13 Mrs. Rita Riina - 49 - had lost entire sight in left eye - given up by specialists; joined Ser. Masses 5/July promising daily com- munion for 6 months ..... Right eye also was very poor. Two months later improvement was manifest. To-day - four months later sight perfect without glasses.
Leo Boudinet - 38 - in oxigen since a week yesterday. Enrolled To- day.
Ralph Tinbusch - 19 - a student in Notre Dame, Ind. slight stroke - lost power in right side - skill weak.
14 Agnes Walburger LaBella - 39 - Very nerveous, for a time paralysis or sleeping sickness feared.
Mrs. Florence O'Gorman - 70 - cancer of stomach .... very ill.
Page 251
Dec. 14 V. Sister Rose Mary - Teaching 12th grade pupils - voice threatened . . . . Wyandotte.
George Droste - 20 - intestinal and stomach.
18 Joseph Walker - 33 - accused of obstructing justice - as being in league with the gamblers.
19 Thanks - John Paspyhala - 48 - Thankful for fearful experiences - Arthritis, estraordinary skin and nail eruption - Given up as hope- lessly incurable - still carries certificate from Ann Arbor Hospital that even though his skin trouble was incurable, "it is neither con- tageous or infectious" ..... Says he never imagined a human being could stand so much and live - must have been a sight without a spear of hair on his head .... His Dr. (Zimmer) urged him to say the rosary to our Bl. Mother ..... his mother came again and again asking prayers and Enrolling him in the Ser. Masses. Now like a second Holy Job says - the experience was beyond price ... would not have missed it for a million dollars ... but would go through it again for ten millions. Lives now at 8918 Helen Ave. Aug. 18, '42 Here again To-day says cure "Miraculous"
